feeds.title: GooseChase » Scavenger Hunt Ideas
feeds.description: Explore ideas and templates to help you run unique and delightful scavenger hunts.GooseChase is an online platform that helps organizers create and run digital scavenger hunt experiences for team building, learning, public engagement, or a variety of other events.

feeds.title: Strayboots Blog
feeds.description: From planning your team-building scavenger hunt to celebrating at the finish, Strayboots makes every step of your experience simple and fun. We started Strayboots based on the idea that exploring your city could be way more fun if you made it into a game. Our mobile scavenger hunts are the most fun, easy and reliable way to engage your company, friends, and colleagues.

feeds.description: Explore all that Eventzee's Scavenger Hunt App has to offer with our most recent customer success stories, new offerings, and more! Use Eventzee to organize your very own, mobile-based scavenger hunt. Whether it's 200 people or 2, Eventzee will take your event to the next level.

feeds.title: Dr Clue Scavenger Hunts Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am David Blum, We produce engaging, interactive team-building events for brainy people who thrive on intellectual challenges. By taking part in a Dr. Clue treasure hunt, you'll stretch your minds and bodies, develop relationships, and practice your strategy, delegation, and team decision-making skills. And you'll have a ton of fun in the process!!

feeds.title: Tourist Scavenger Hunt Blog

Scavenger Hunts challenge you to observe and engage with your surroundings, instead of just rushing by in that way, scavenger hunts are perfect for travel and nature.

feeds.title: Scavenger Box Blog

Creating an amazing adventure has never been so easy and fun! Scavenger Box was born out of our journey to find the perfect gift and create an unforgettable experience. Our mission is to make it easy to create magical moments and experiences for the people you love.

feeds.title: Scavify Blog

Build and launch your experiences right here through our website and then find it in our app for all of your participants to play.
